items.title: 10.27 Winkler method, BOD and DO (numbered 10.27 as printed) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the topic printed as 10.27 with Figure 10.12, printed pages 239-240.

blocks.text: Biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) natural (qudrati) pani mein maujood organic substance (madda) ki paanch din mein oxygen kharch karne ki ability (salahiyat) hai. BOD ki value woh oxygen hai jo sample (namoona) mein ghule hue organic substance ke biological oxidation mein kharch hoti hai. Yeh oxidation pani mein pehle se maujood microorganisms (bohat chhote jaandar jo sirf microscope se nazar aate hain) catalyze karte hain. BOD Winkler method se napi jati hai: paanch din ke shuru aur aakhir mein oxygen ki concentration napi jati hai, jabke band (sealed) sample andhere mein 25°C ke constant (na badalne wala) temperature par rakha jata hai.

blocks.alt: Darya ke bahao ki direction (simt) ke muqable concentration ka graph. Dissolved Oxygen (solid line) ooncha hai, achanak gir kar kam tareen hota hai aur phir aahista dobara ooncha ho jata hai. BOD (dotted line) neecha hai, usi jagah tezi se peak (chotti) tak charhta hai aur phir aahista girta hai, DO ke curve ko kaat-ta hua.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.12: BOD aur DO ka inverse relationship (ulta taalluq) (kitab ki Figure 10.12 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jahan darya mein organic substance (maslan ganda pani) milta hai, wahan bacteria use torne ke liye oxygen kharch karte hain: BOD tezi se barhta hai aur DO tezi se girta hai. Aage chal kar organic substance khatam hota hai to BOD ghatta hai aur hawa se oxygen ghulne par DO dobara barh jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 10.12 mein ‘Disolved Oxygen’ chhapa hai; sahi spelling ‘Dissolved Oxygen’ hai.

Dissolved oxygen (DO) pani mein ghuli hui oxygen ki amount (miqdar) hai. Yeh oxygen ya to hawa (atmosphere) se ghulti hai ya pani ke paude photosynthesis mein chhorte hain. DO ki concentration 5 se 8 mg/dm³ hoti hai. DO kam se kam 5 mg/dm³ honi chahiye; 5 mg/dm³ se kam ho to pani polluted (ganda) samjha jata hai.
DO aur BOD ka inverse (ulta) relationship hai, jaisa Figure 10.12 mein hai. Jab bacteria organic substance torte hue pani ki oxygen kharch karte hain to BOD barhta hai aur DO kam ho jata hai.

Winkler method pani ke namoonon mein dissolved oxygen (DO) napne ka tareeqa hai. Is ka basis (bunyad) yeh hai ke sample ki ghuli hui oxygen oxidizing property (khasiyat) rakhti hai aur KI se react kar ke iodine banati hai. Bani hui iodine ko sodium thiosulfate se titrate kar ke napa jata hai; starch indicator solution ko gehra neela (dark blue) karta hai jo endpoint batata hai. Bani hui iodine ki amount solution ki dissolved oxygen ke proportional (saath saath barhne wala) hai.

blocks.prompt: Zyada BOD wala pani polluted kyun samjha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Zyada BOD ka matlab pani mein bohat organic substance (ganda pani, kachra) hai jise bacteria torte hue zyada oxygen kharch karte hain. Is se DO 5 mg/dm³ se neeche gir jati hai aur machhliyan aur pani ke doosre living things (jaandar) mar sakte hain.

items: BOD: 5 din mein organic substance ke microbial oxidation mein kharch oxygen (band, andhera, 25°C).
DO: 5 se 8 mg/dm³; 5 se kam = polluted; BOD aur DO ulte badalte hain.
Winkler: ghuli O₂ KI se iodine banati hai; thiosulfate se titration, starch se gehra neela endpoint.
